De Zerbi on purpose of Spain training camp

12 Oct 2026

-->

Roberto De Zerbi wants to build on the team spirit shown in Saturday's Premier League 1-1 draw with Manchester United during the squad's training camp in Spain this week.

On top for large spells in an impressive first-half display which ended goalless, Bryan Mbeumo's opener on 73 minutes and Rodrigo Bentancur's red card five minutes later threatened to derail our positive momentum.

Instead, our 10 men rallied well in the closing stages and found a deserved equaliser when first-time captain Dominic Solanke opened his account for the season with a glancing header in the 92nd minute.

Roberto on why he made Dominic Solanke captain at Old Trafford

11 Oct 2026

-->

Our Head Coach praised the team's togetherness to salvage a point at Old Trafford and sees the training camp in Marbella as a chance to strengthen those connections and bring a new-look team even closer with the nine-day gap to Coventry City next Monday (kick-off 8pm UK).
